lines.zh: 我的触须先探过你的肩。
lines.en: My tentacle reaches past your shoulder first.
Swinging tentacles around
Muttering shadows
Slowly gliding towards prey
Sliding in the dark
Tentacles sensing you
Hiding in the shadows
Tentacles chasing your shadow
Shadows sway inside my tentacles.
Moving quietly in the dark
My glassy bell drifts toward you.

lines.zh: 飘过烛火照不到的角落
lines.en: I drift past corners the torchlight never reaches.

lines.zh: 我贴在洞顶，像一片湿布。
lines.en: I cling to the ceiling like wet cloth.
Lazily swinging tentacles
Hiding in the dark
Patiently watching for prey
Slowly moving, searching for prey
Waiting for a target to appear
Silently waiting in the dark
Sliding slowly, searching for prey
Stationary, observing the environment
Patiently waiting in the shadows
My bell pulses like slow breathing.
I hang from the rafters, tentacles dangling.
A faint violet glow leaks from my dark corner.
I wait patiently for something alive to come close.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我就漂近一寸。
lines.en: Each step you take, I drift an inch closer.
In the dark I pulse, shrinking and swelling.
Noticing your movements
Tracing your path

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，却看得见你。
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I see you.

lines.zh: 我浮在暗处，看不出轮廓。
lines.en: I float in the dark, barely a shape.

lines.zh: 我悬着，触须比你呼吸还慢。
lines.en: I hang, tentacles slower than your breath.

lines.zh: 我顺着洞壁滑向你身后。
lines.en: I slide down the cave wall behind you.
In the shadow, my tentacles spread.
Staring at you, looking for an opportunity
Your torchlight cannot pierce me.
I float slowly above your head.
My tentacles hang level with your face.
I count the sounds of your steps.
The light reaches me, and I shrink back a pace.
Your shadow has snagged on me.
I am waiting for you to put the torch down.
Do not look up. I am above you.
Tentacles are entangled.
Body is torn.
Tail is trapped.
Joint is twisted.
Scratched by a hard object.

lines.zh: 半截触手掉进水里，还在动。
lines.en: Half a tentacle drops into the water, still moving.
Something is stuck to it.
Body is stretched.
Tentacles are pierced.
Something is caught on it.

lines.zh: 它缓缓向你游来，触须闪烁着幽光。
lines.en: It slowly approaches you, tentacles glowing faintly.

lines.zh: 你感到它的触须轻轻碰触皮肤。
lines.en: You feel its tentacles gently touch your skin.

lines.zh: 它的身体发出微弱的荧光，吸引着你。
lines.en: Its body emits a faint glow, drawing you in.

lines.zh: 它的眼珠闪烁着恶毒的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with malevolent intent.

lines.zh: 它的触须缠绕在你的脚上。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around your ankles.

lines.zh: 它的口器张开，露出尖锐的牙齿。
lines.en: Its mouth opens, revealing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 它的身影在水中显得格外透明。
lines.en: Its silhouette is particularly transparent in the water.

lines.zh: 它的体液散发出腐烂的气味。
lines.en: Its bodily fluids emit a decaying odor.

lines.zh: 你感受到它的威胁，心跳加速。
lines.en: You feel its threat, your heart racing.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着你，仿佛在计算。
lines.en: Its eyes stare at you, calculating your fate.

lines.zh: 触须突然碰触你的身体。
lines.en: Tentacles suddenly touch your body.
You collide with its tentacles.

lines.zh: 触须紧紧缠住你的四肢。
lines.en: Tentacles tightly ensnare your limbs.

lines.zh: 碰撞使它发出痛苦的嘶鸣。
lines.en: It emits a painful hiss upon impact.

lines.zh: 你被它的触须卷入其中。
lines.en: You get caught in its tentacles.

lines.zh: 它的触须迅速抓住你的背包。
lines.en: Its tentacles quickly grab your backpack.

lines.zh: 触须缠绕在你的武器上。
lines.en: Tentacles wrap around your weapon.

lines.zh: 碰撞后它的身体突然膨胀。
lines.en: Its body suddenly inflates upon impact.

lines.zh: 你感到一阵强烈的撕扯。
lines.en: You feel a strong tearing sensation.

lines.zh: 碰撞使它更紧地贴住你。
lines.en: The impact makes it cling to you more tightly.

lines.zh: 它的触须缠绕在另一只身上。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around another one.

lines.zh: 它与另一只交缠在一起。
lines.en: It entwines with another one.

lines.zh: 触须之间传递着神秘的信息。
lines.en: Mysterious messages are transmitted through the tentacles.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着繁殖的欲望。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with the desire to reproduce.

lines.zh: 它的触须轻轻触碰对方的身体。
lines.en: Its tentacles gently touch the other one's body.

lines.zh: 它们的身体逐渐融合在一起。
lines.en: Their bodies gradually merge together.

lines.zh: 它们之间的触须相互连接。
lines.en: Their tentacles connect with each other.
It emits a low mating sound.

lines.zh: 触须之间发出轻微的摩擦声。
lines.en: A slight rubbing sound is heard between the tentacles.

lines.zh: 它们的身体开始缓慢移动。
lines.en: Their bodies move slowly together.
Ripple, ripple.
Tentacles grab, beware.
Be absorbed, taste this.
Tentacles everywhere.
My tendrils hang down and touch you.

lines.zh: 阴影中游弋，猎物自投罗网。
lines.en: Swim in shadows, prey finds me.

lines.zh: 黑暗是我的盔甲，也是武器。
lines.en: Darkness is my armor, my weapon.
Consume all, fuel my energy.
Tentacles wrap, no escape.
My tentacles tighten and haul you up.
Your position, noted.
Sense you here.
Prey's scent, grows closer.
Tentacles seek, nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 阴影下的秘密，即将揭晓。
lines.en: Shadow's secret, revealed.
Your scent, caught in my net.

lines.zh: 黑暗中等待，你终将被吞噬。
lines.en: Wait in darkness, to be devoured.
Tentacles bind, your fate.

lines.zh: 阴影中的猎物，已成俘虏。
lines.en: Captured prey, in the shadows.
All is mine, in the end.
A violet glow has settled on you.
My tentacles have reached your feet.
You have waded into my water.
My bell is sinking toward you.
I have picked your body heat out of the dark.
Your breathing stirred me awake.

lines.zh: 你火把的光，先被我吸走。
lines.en: First I drink the light of your torch.
Tentacles surround you.
Writhing in my grip.
Fear in the dark.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖正一点点包下来。
lines.en: My bell is slowly folding over you.

lines.zh: 陷入我的阴影，求生不得。
lines.en: Caught in my shadow, no escape.

lines.zh: 吞噬你的灵魂，化为养料。
lines.en: Consume your soul, feed my growth.
Tentacles bind, you're trapped.
Darkness is your grave.
Tentacles release, you're mine.
My tentacles climb along your arm.
I draw the light out of the room, bit by bit.
My bell has closed over your head.
The more you struggle, the tighter I coil.
Your heartbeat makes me glow.
Ink-dark mist spreads out from me.
A tentacle tip rests at your neck.
No one will hear the sounds you make.
I am closing the circle slowly.

lines.zh: 你的影子已经被我吞了
lines.en: I have already swallowed your shadow.

lines.zh: 发出紫色光芒，触手缠绕！
lines.en: Emitting purple light, tentacles ensnare!
Tentacles wrap, no escape!

lines.zh: 紫色触手撕裂你的皮肤！
lines.en: Purple tentacles rip your skin!
Tentacles suffocate, slowly!
Your blood turns purple!
Tentacles squeeze, unbearable pain!
You are devoured by purple light!
Tentacles immobilize you!
Purple tentacles grip tightly!
You are trapped by purple light!
A tentacle lashes out and your skin goes numb!
Violet light jabs into you!
It sticks, and you cannot tear it off!
My cold venom is in your veins!
My bell snaps shut and everything goes black!
Tentacles seize your leg!
I have wrapped you in my shadow!
You gasp, and there is only cold!
Slither in the dark!
I rise out of the sound of dripping water.
Swim in dark corners!
Dive into the shadows!
Float gently underwater!
Silently appear from the dark!
Swim toward a new prey!
Move slowly in the shadows!
Lurk in the darkness!
Emerge silently in the dark!
A bell surfaces out of the dark.

lines.zh: 触须先垂下来，然后是我
lines.en: The tentacles come first, then the rest of me.
I congeal where there is no light.
A violet smear drifts out of the damp air.
Shadow gathers into something that breathes.
I lower myself from the ceiling.
The Shade Jelly surfaces without a sound.
I arrive the moment the lamp dies.
Fire burns — and I fear the light too.
Fell from height.
Tentacles are tangled in water.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖被震得散了一半。
lines.en: Half my bell has been blown apart.
Hit by projectile.
Hit by magic.
Starved for a long time.

lines.zh: 雷光透过我半透明的伞盖。
lines.en: Lightning glows through my translucent bell.
Fell into void.
